permission.profile.deleteAccount.descrip: Let a member close their own account from the account pages, with their password.
permission.profile.signature.description: Show a signature under one's posts.
permission.profile.customTitle.descripti: Show a title of one's own under the name instead of the group or level title.
permission.profile.coverPreset: Choose a profile cover from the gallery
permission.profile.coverPreset.descripti: Choose a profile cover from the gallery of preset covers.
permission.profile.renameFree.descriptio: Change one's own username without spending a shop item.
permission.profile.awardSlots: Awards shown next to the name
permission.profile.awardSlots.descriptio: How many awards a member shows next to their name.
permission.conversation.editOwn.descript: Edit your own messages in conversations you take part in, within the time limit to edit them.
permission.conversation.deleteOwn.descri: Delete your own messages (not the first one) in conversations you take part in.
permission.admin.appearance.description: Manage the picture and colour catalogs members choose their appearance from.
permission.tag.apply.description: Put tags on a thread: its author, and staff on any thread. Only tags that already exist unless the group may also create tags. A posting restriction takes it away; taking a tag off stays possible. A group that manages tags may put tags on any thread without it.
permission.tag.create.description: Make a tag nobody used before, by listing it on a thread or by typing a new #hashtag in an opening post. Without it, a #word that is not a tag stays plain text.
permission.tag.manage.description: Rename, merge and delete tags on the tags screen of the staff panel.
permission.poll.create.description: Add a poll or a quiz to one's own thread, or write it with a new thread. A posting restriction takes it away.
permission.poll.vote.description: Vote in a poll, or answer a quiz, in a thread the member can read.
permission.poll.addAnswer.description: Add an answer of one's own to a poll that allows it. A posting restriction takes it away.
permission.poll.closeOwn.description: Close and reopen the polls the member made.
permission.poll.closeAny.description: Close and reopen any poll of the forum.
permission.poll.viewVoters.description: See which members voted for each answer of a poll that is not anonymous, once its results are shown to them.
permission.poll.manage.description: Edit and delete any poll or quiz of the forum, and add one to any thread.
permission.antispam.postsPerDay.descript: Most posts (replies and new threads) a member may make in 24 hours. -1 or 0 is no limit.
permission.antispam.threadsPerDay.descri: Most new threads a member may start in 24 hours. -1 or 0 is no limit.
Most conversations a member may start in 24 hours. -1 or 0 is no limit.
permission.antispam.negativeReactionsPer: Most reactions with a negative score a member may give in 24 hours. -1 or 0 is no limit.
permission.antispam.externalMediaAsLinks: Show outside pictures and media as links
Pictures and media from other sites in the member's text are shown as links instead of being embedded. Administrators are never held to it.
permission.antispam.bypassFlood.descript: Write again sooner than the site's flood interval allows.
permission.antispam.bypassWordFilter.des: Post without the word filter replacing or holding back the text.
permission.antispam.bypassSpamCheck.desc: Post without the external spam check judging the text.
permission.profile.renameNeedsApproval.d: Members cannot change their own username and are told to ask staff, who can rename them. There is no request queue.
permission.profile.renameLimit.descripti: Most username changes a member may make within the days below. -1 is no limit and 0 allows none; of a member's groups the highest wins. Every change counts, free or bought.
permission.profile.renameWindowDays: Days the username change limit covers
permission.profile.renameWindowDays.desc: The days the limit above counts back over. -1 counts every change ever made. 0 is the same as unset: it counts every change unless one of the member's groups sets days. When groups differ the longest applies.
permission.content.editSilently.descript: Edits to posts, wall posts, comments and messages leave no edited note. The earlier text is still kept where revisions are kept, and staff reading a post's history still see the edit.
permission.attachment.maxFileSize.descri: Largest file, in bytes, a member may upload as an attachment, avatar or cover, under the site's own limit; it can lower that limit but never raise it. -1 leaves only the site's limit and 0 allows no file.
permission.site.view.description: Open forums, threads, the feed, search, profiles and the member list.
permission.profile.uploadAvatar.descript: Upload or set an avatar. Taking it off needs nothing.
permission.profile.uploadCover.descripti: Upload or set a profile cover. Taking it off needs nothing.
permission.bookmark.create.description: Bookmark threads, posts and conversations. Taking a bookmark off needs nothing.
permission.reaction.viewList.description: Open the list of who reacted to an item. The counts are always visible.
permission.member.viewFollowing: See the members a member follows
permission.member.viewFollowing.descript: Open the list of members another member follows. A member always sees their own.
permission.profilePost.react.description: React to wall posts and their comments, as well as having permission to react.
permission.profilePost.view.description: Read wall posts and their comments, on any profile.
permission.conversation.editOwnTimeLimit: Time limit to edit own messages
Minutes after sending within which a member may edit their own conversation messages. -1 is unlimited.
permission.conversation.react.descriptio: React to conversation messages, as well as having permission to react.
permission.profilePost.postOwn.descripti: Post on one's own profile. Posting on other members' profiles is the permission to post on profiles.
permission.forum.viewOwnHistory: See the edit history of own posts
permission.forum.viewOwnHistory.descript: Read the earlier versions of one's own posts, the ones the member edited themselves.
permission.conversation.alwaysInvite.des: Start a conversation with, or add, members who ignore the holder.
permission.forum.editOwnTimeLimit.descri: Allows forum edit own time limit.
permission.forum.editOwnThreadTitle.desc: Allows forum edit own thread title.
permission.forum.deleteOwn.description: Let a member hide their own replies (staff can restore them). The opening post goes with its thread.
permission.profilePost.manageOwnWall.des: Allows profile post manage own wall.
permission.member.immuneToAutoBan.descri: Allows member immune to auto ban.
permission.member.approveRegistrations.d: See the new accounts that wait for approval and approve or reject them. Matters only while the site approves new accounts by hand.
permission.member.viewIps.description: See the IP addresses members signed in, registered and posted from, and which members share an address.
permission.credits.adjust.description: Allows giving or taking credits with a reason and queuing a balance repair.
permission.credits.viewAny.description: Allows viewing any member's credit balance and history or the full ledger.
permission.award.grant.description: Allows granting awards to members by hand and revoking individual grants.
permission.shop.buy.description: Allows buying shop items and using items in your own inventory.
permission.shop.gift.description: Allows buying giftable items for other members when you also have permission to buy shop items.
permission.admin.creditRules.description: Allows listing, creating, changing and deleting rules that give or take credits for member activity.
permission.admin.awards.description: Allows managing awards, viewing inactive awards and criteria, and queuing an automatic award sweep.
permission.admin.shop.description: Allows managing shop categories and items, viewing the purchase log and reading any member's inventory.
criterion.post_count.description: The member must have at least the specified number of posts.
criterion.days_registered.description: The member must have been registered for at least the specified number of days.
criterion.reaction_score.description: The member's reaction score must be at least the specified value.
criterion.email_verified.description: Whether the member's email address is verified.
criterion.has_avatar.description: Whether the member has uploaded an avatar.
criterion.active_within_days.description: The member's last activity must be within the specified number of days.
criterion.inactive_days.description: The member must have been inactive for at least the specified number of days.
criterion.warning_points_below.descripti: The member's current warning points must be below the specified value.
criterion.credits_at_least.description: The member's balance must be at least the specified number of credits.
criterion.credits_at_most.description: The member's balance must be at most the specified number of credits, including negative balances.
criterion.purchased_item.description: The member must have bought the item with the specified ID, either for themselves or as a gift.
criterion.purchases_at_least.description: The member must have bought at least the specified number of units across all items, including gifts they paid for.
criterion.is_guest.description: Whether the visitor is signed out (a guest) rather than a member.
criterion.in_group.description: The member must be in at least one of the listed groups, as their primary group or a group assigned by hand.
criterion.not_in_group.description: The member must be in none of the listed groups, as their primary group or a group assigned by hand.
criterion.is_member.description: The member must be one of the listed members.
criterion.posts_in_threads.description: The member must have posted in the chosen threads: at least the number asked in each of them, in any one of them, or in all of them added together.
criterion.replies_received: Replies on their threads, their own included
criterion.replies_received.description: The visible replies in the member's own visible threads must add up to at least the specified number. The member's own replies count too.
criterion.busiest_thread_replies.descrip: The member's thread with the most replies must have at least the specified number of them.
criterion.profile_posts_written.descript: The member must have written at least the specified number of visible profile posts, on any wall.
criterion.profile_comments_written.descr: The member must have written at least the specified number of visible comments on profile posts.
criterion.attachments_uploaded.descripti: The member must have uploaded at least the specified number of attachments that are in use.
criterion.bookmarks_at_least.description: The member must have at least the specified number of bookmarks.
criterion.watching_forums_at_least.descr: The member must watch at least the specified number of forums.
criterion.watching_threads_at_least.desc: The member must watch at least the specified number of threads.
criterion.owns_item.description: The member must currently hold the chosen shop items: any one of them, or each of them. An item in effect, or a consumable with units left, counts; an expired or used-up one does not.
criterion.wears_item.description: The member must hold the chosen shop items and have the frame, name color or name icon they give in use: any one of them, or each of them.
criterion.bought_in_category.description: The member must have bought something, for themselves or as a gift, in the chosen shop categories: any one of them, or each of them.
criterion.gifted_items.description: The member must have paid for at least the specified number of units that went to other members.
criterion.credits_earned.description: The credits the member earned from credit rules and awards, net of what was taken back, must reach the specified number, in total or within the last days chosen. Adjustments and shop purchases do not count.
criterion.credits_from_rule.description: The credits the chosen credit rules paid the member must reach the specified number: from any one rule, from each rule, or from all of them added together, in total or within the last days chosen.
criterion.awards_held_at_least.descripti: The member must hold at least the specified number of award grants: an award that can be held more than once counts once for each grant.
criterion.tags_added_at_least.descriptio: The member must have put at least the specified number of tags on threads that are visible and still carry them (their own or others', by the tags field or the hashtags of an opening post). The count rises and falls as tags are added and removed, and as threads are hidden, held for approval or brought back.
criterion.polls_voted_at_least: Polls and quizzes taken part in
criterion.polls_voted_at_least.descripti: The member must have voted in at least the specified number of polls, or answered at least one question of that many quizzes. A poll or quiz deleted for good lowers the count, but the rule is only looked at again when the member next takes part (or by a sweep), so nothing is taken back at once. It is a counter kept on the member, so it is cheap to check.
criterion.award_xp_at_most.description: The XP of the awards the member holds must be at most the specified number. An automatic award is decided once, when it is given: it is never taken back if the XP later rises.
criterion.holds_awards.description: About the chosen awards: the member holds at least one of them, holds none of them, or holds each of them. An automatic award is decided once, when it is given. An award cannot require itself, directly or through other awards.
criterion.has_cover.description: Whether the member has a profile cover, uploaded or chosen from the gallery.
criterion.has_name_color.description: Whether the member has chosen a color for their name.
criterion.has_accent_color.description: Whether the member has chosen an accent color.
criterion.has_frame.description: Whether the member wears an avatar frame.
criterion.social_links_at_least.descript: The member must have filled in at least the specified number of their Discord, Telegram and X handles.
criterion.profile_complete.description: Whether the member has an avatar, an about text, a location and a birthday.
criterion.username_changed_within_days.d: The member's username must have changed within the specified number of days.
criterion.restricted_posting.description: Whether the member has an active restriction on posting.
criterion.restricted_conversations.descr: Whether the member has an active restriction on conversations.
criterion.restricted_profile_posts.descr: Whether the member has an active restriction on profile posts.
criterion.thread_banned.description: Whether the member is banned from at least one thread, with the ban still in force.
criterion.banned_before.description: Whether the member has ever been banned: any ban on record counts, current or over.
criterion.reports_resolved.description: The member must have filed at least the specified number of reports that a moderator resolved. Rejected reports do not count.
criterion.moderator_actions.description: The member must have taken at least the specified number of moderator actions, as recorded in the moderator log.
criterion.days_since_last_post.descripti: The member's last visible post, in a visible thread, must be at least the specified number of days old. A member who has never posted does not qualify.
criterion.mentioned_by_others.descriptio: The member must have been mentioned at least the specified number of times in other members' posts, profile posts and profile post comments.
criterion.referrals_at_least.description: The member must have referred at least the specified number of members.
criterion.was_referred.description: Whether the member joined through another member's referral.
criterion.referrals_this_month.descripti: The member must have referred at least the specified number of members since the first of this month.
criterion.quoted_by_others.description: The member's posts must have been quoted at least the specified number of times in other members' posts, profile posts and profile post comments.
criterion.reactions_given_by_type.descri: The reactions the member gave of the chosen types must reach the specified number: of any one type, of each type, or of all of them added together.
criterion.reactions_received_by_type.des: The reactions the member's content received of the chosen types must reach the specified number: of any one type, of each type, or of all of them added together.
criterion.most_reacted_post.description: The member's most-reacted visible post, in a visible thread, must have at least the specified number of reactions.
credits.trigger.reply_received: Receiving a reply to your thread
credits.trigger.profile_post_received: Receiving a post on your profile
permission.forum.deleteOwnThread.descrip: Let a member hide a thread they started (staff can restore it).
permission.forum.hardDeleteOwn: Delete own posts and threads for good
permission.forum.hardDeleteOwn.descripti: Let a member remove their own posts and threads completely, in one step. Content staff hid stays out of reach, and a thread holding other members' posts or over 500 posts is refused.
permission.forum.lockOwn.description: Let a member lock a thread they started, and unlock it again when they locked it themselves.
permission.forum.react.description: React to posts here, as well as holding the site-wide reaction permission.
permission.forum.viewOthers.description: Open threads other members started. Granted unless a group says never; with never a member sees only their own threads in this forum.
permission.forum.viewContent.description: Read the posts of a thread. Granted unless a group says never; with never only titles are listed and the posts are closed, even those of the member's own thread; a member can still open a single post they wrote, to edit it.
permission.forum.warn: Warn about posts in this forum
permission.forum.warn.description: Warn a member about one of their posts here (a warning with a post). A warning without a post follows the site-wide warn permission. Forum moderators hold it with their other tools.
permission.warning.delete.description: Delete a warning, or end it early so it stops counting. Only for members who rank below.
permission.warning.maxPoints.description: The most points one warning may carry, a type's or a custom value. -1 is unlimited, 0 allows none; with no value in any of the member's groups, 10.
permission.warning.perDay.description: How many warnings one moderator may give in 24 hours. -1 is unlimited, 0 allows none; with no value in any of the member's groups, 20.
permission.member.editProfile: Edit the basic profile of members
permission.member.editProfile.descriptio: Edit another member's about text, location, links, signature and pictures. Only for members who rank below.
permission.member.banMaxDays.description: The longest ban the holder may give, in days. -1 allows permanent bans, 0 allows none; with no value in any of the member's groups, 30. Banning also needs the ban permission.
permission.admin.prefixes.description: Create, change, order and remove the labels members put on threads.
permission.admin.navigation.description: Edit the links of the header, footer and menus.
permission.admin.widgets.description: Add, change, order and remove the blocks drawn on the home page, the feed page and the member pages.
permission.admin.pages.description: Create, edit, publish and delete pages such as the terms and the rules.
